method.loads: Actual 2 ms contact loads, all_steps; no assumed equal sharing between hands.
method.envelope: Per-component absolute maxima form a conservative envelope over all recorded samples; not a simultaneous measured wrench.
method.normal: Axial plus biaxial bending from the full 2x2 section inertia matrix; evaluate section vertices.
method.torsion: Saint-Venant rectangle J approximation; tau approximately T*short_side/J. Rear open U uses the sum of its three finite-width rectangle J values.
method.transverse_shear: 1.5*(abs(Vu)/Au + abs(Vv)/Av); rear U uses base area 68 and combined rib area 48 mm2.
method.combination: von Mises upper estimate sqrt(sigma_bound^2 + 3*(tau_torsion + tau_transverse_bound)^2).
method.reserve_meaning: The simulation already contains modeled dynamics. Factor 3 is an extra conservative reserve, not a measured dynamic amplification.

limitations: Ideal beam-section arithmetic only; not full 3D FEA or material certification.
Shoulder and cup cases contain the contact-wrench contribution only; full limb gravity/inertia internal stress is not reconstructed.
Does not certify creep, fatigue, print anisotropy, local warping, notch stresses, screw bearing, screw pullout or motor plastic.
Does not validate glue strength, TPU friction or hardware temperature and durability.
Other printed components and fasteners are outside this actual-load audit; see the separate simple strength_screen report.
